GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down 4.5 Lengths Two Wide , Made Some Ground to 2 Lengths Two Wide turning, shifted 3 Wide rounding turn, kept coming in Straight # battled on ok

Jumped awkwardly, taken straight across & Settled Down 10 Lengths Two Wide , hooked 3 Wide at 750m, Made Some Ground to 7 Lengths Two Wide turning, one-paced in straight. [Stewards: Raced keenly early/middle stages.] # only plugged
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly. Raced keenly in the early and middle stages. Rounding the turn at the 1500m was steadied when the tempo of the race slackened and got its head up on a number of occasions.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay, taken across & Settled Down 6 Lengths on fence, Hooked Out 3 Wide at 650m and Moved Up to 2 Lengths 3 Wide turning, Held Ground in Straight # Wide last 650m
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Eased near the 800m when in restricted room to the inside of SHOWMAN which had shifted in. Over the concluding stages was brushed by BROKLYN DAISY, which had shifted out.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped very awkwardly & Settled Down Mid Field 5.5 Lengths Two Wide , Hooked Out 3 Wide at 650m, Moved Up to 4 Lengths 3 Wide turning, laid out rounding turn, Made Some Ground in straight. (Blinkers OFF AGAIN) [Stewards: Raced ungenerously for majority of race.] # Wide last 650m
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began very awkwardly and shifted in. Approaching the 1600m, restrained when racing keen and close to heels. Raced ungenerously for the majority of the race. After being brushed near the 400m, lay in and became unbalanced.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok , enjoyed rails trail behind speed 2 Lengths 800m, stayed back inside but could not finish race off well enough # did not finish off
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Leaving the 1200m commenced to race with its head up and when being restrained made contact with rail and became unbalanced.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: no rush off the Wide gate drifted back to slot in settled last couple Two Wide 10 Lengths (1000m), field bunched this still last couple Turn , Under Whip plugged home only # back/never close

Jumped awkwardly & Settled Down Mid Field 5 Lengths on fence, made no ground to turn, shifetd Two Wide on turn, boxed in and Held Up until 200m, got wider and ran on hitting narrow Lead at 100m, raced head'n'head to line # solid win
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly. Held up for clear running from approaching the 400m until the 200m. Laid in under pressure in the home straight.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped awkwardly then worked forward from the Wide gate & trailed Four Wide by 0.75 Lengths as the field settled down, Eased and back in 3 Wide at 1000m and Two Wide at 800m, held together much same to turn 2 Lengths 3 Wide With Cover , Dropped Out in Straight # Wide early/weakened
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly then bumped by ZOUSAIN GIRL. Raced wide without cover in the early stages until finding cover near the 800m. Laid in under pressure in the straight.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok , sat 4th Two Wide 4 Lengths 1000m, stayed back inside runners but was only one paced # one paced
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Travelled keenly in the early and middle stages. A post-race veterinary examination revealed no abnormalities.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok , sat on Leaders heels 1 Lengths 1000m, Hard Ridden on the corner and only battled in Straight , blinkers again # on pace/battled
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: On entering the home straight momentarily hampered.
